localChanges: The three element-bound controllers became pure functions over a LiveSample (currentTime, paused, buffered ranges, playbackRate, readyState); the caller applies the seek / rate. Same conditions and thresholds as upstream (defaults from src/config.js).
Logging dropped; config object replaced by the typed LatencyConfig.
2026-10-22 (ADR-010 §4): optional LiveSample.edge, the live edge on the media timeline when the engine knows it apart from the buffer (HLS); latency is measured to it instead of the buffer end.

syncLog.reason: vendor-sync drift report: live-latency-chaser, live-latency-synchronizer, startup-stall-jumper changed only in typing (= null -> definite assignment, null!) and let -> const. The L3 copy keeps the decision rules as pure functions, unaffected.
